senses.gloss: भ्रेज् vi. 1Ā (pres. भ्रेजते) To shine, to glitter.
भ्रेश् vi. 1U (pres. भ्रेशति-ते, भ्लेशति-ते) 1. To go, to move; 2. to fall, to totter; 3. to be angry; 4. to fear.
भ्रेश m. 1. Going, moving; 2. loss, deprivation; 3. deviation, straying from proper course.
